nom: COSRX The Alpha-Arbutin 2 Discoloration Care Serum

segments.oily: One reviewer with acne-prone skin notes the serum absorbs quickly, doesn't clog pores, and works well on oily/acne-prone skin (29).
segments.dry: A reviewer suggests the product suits normal-to-dry skin well for discoloration and uneven tone, though a few others note the serum itself left skin feeling dry when used without extra moisturizer.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin reports it hydrates where needed without clogging pores while also fading dark spots (34).
segments.sensitive: Many reviewers describe sensitive, reactive, rosacea-prone or eczema-prone skin; most report no irritation or breakouts and gradual fading of dark spots, but a few report hives, purging, or advise using with caution on sensitive skin.
segments.mature: Reviewers mention age spots and mature-skin concerns, reporting visible lightening of age/sun spots with continued use.

concerns.aging: Reviewers with age spots and sun damage report visible fading and more even tone over one to several weeks, with results generally described as gradual rather than immediate.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the serum as lightweight, non-greasy and even hydrating; however, a couple report the serum made their skin feel dry or that they needed extra moisturizer alongside it.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report calming of redness from rosacea, breakouts, or post-pimple marks, including one describing quick reduction of an active breakout's redness; no reviewer reports increased redness.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with reactive, eczema-prone or very sensitive skin generally report the serum is gentle and non-irritating, though one describes purging when first introducing it and another reports hives when applied to larger body areas.
concerns.spots: The large majority of reviewers report visible fading of dark spots, hyperpigmentation, sun spots or age spots within one to three weeks; a smaller group says it is too early to tell or that they saw no change after a week.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers with acne-prone skin report fewer new breakouts and faster fading of post-acne marks, while a couple report new breakouts or a sticky feeling during use.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer notes the serum mattifies and does not feel oily or heavy; no reviewer describes it increasing oiliness.

aspects.libelle: No fragrance or very faint scent
Slow to show results, needs patience
Can dry out skin with use

extraits.texte: I love this serum. I have very sensitive skin and this product doesn't cause me any breakouts or reactions, that is huge to me. There are age spots, sun spots and acne scars on my face, I do feel like this product is fading my dark spots. I also have combination skin and this serum is helping hydrate my skin where needed without clogging my pores. This serum is now a part of my daily routine and I plan to continue using it. I would definitely suggest trying this serum!

I have been using this since May and I will say its nice to have a product that addresses all sides of hyperpigmentation especially for black people. Very well formulated and a huge bottle. I use it 4x a week once a day. I have reactive super sensitive acne prone skin and eczema so I definitely purged. I started off slow 1x a week for 2 weeks the went up from there. You have to be serious about using sunscreen and a hat. Any serum will take a while to work nothing is magic in a bottle but if youre patient its worth it for older marks. New marks barely leave a mark and goes away fast. I combined mine with microneedling and my skin looks wayyyy different.

I have very reactive sensitive rosacea-prone skin and this serum has helped immensely for my acne hyperpigmentation without irritating my skin. I have very reactive skin that I cant even use vitamin C derivatives. This serum has no vitamin C or exfoliating acids, so its perfect for sensitive skin. It's definitely slow acting and you have to be very consistent with it but i can see my dark spots fading faster than if I didnt use anything.
This serum works great on my acne scars, after 2 weeks of use I can see them fading off. But it makes my skin super dry

This product was perfect for discoloration and making surface even tone. I have different things going on with my skin,like scarring from keloids that are red and refuse to lighten. It worked for a dark spot under my eye and generally lightened the scars but I did have a slight problem with breakouts and the serum feeling sticky. Overall, I could see this working for someone Normal to dry skin that had a lot of dark spots and uneven tones.

extraits.titre: Works good but if you have sensitive skin use with caution.
extraits.texte: I really think this has faded my dark spots, but with me having sensitive skin I can't use it on my arms, chest and legs too without breaking out in hives. Just pick a few spots at a time if you have sensitive skin.

extraits.titre: First Thing I've Tried That Works
extraits.texte: I have pale skin prone to redness and age spots. I've tried many different serums with no luck. This actually worked on me. Within one week I have my normal skin coloring and no irritation.
